$comment: D-CSUBSET-LONG-DOUBLE-CONTROL-MERGE: the runtime witness for a `long double` crossing a CONTROL-FLOW JOIN, on every long-double axis. An F80/F128 SSA value is the GPR-held ADDRESS of its memory home (LD-1/LD-2), so a phi cannot be a register move — it is a MEMORY-HOME merge: the phi owns a frame home, its per-edge staging home sits beside it, and each incoming edge copies the datum in (fld_m80/fstp_m80 on the x87-80 axis; a two-word GPR copy on the ieee128 axis, through the one shared `emitWideFloatHomeCopy` verb, dispatched on TypeKind alone). ✔MEASURED BEFORE THE CHANGE: this exact source REFUSED with `L_UnsupportedLoweringForOpcode` ("control-flow merge (phi) is not yet lowered") at BOTH `--config=debug` AND `--config=release` on x86_64:elf64-x86_64-linux-exec (F80) and arm64:elf64-aarch64-linux-exec (F128) — the baseline was FAIL LOUD with no binary, never a wrong answer — while the f64 axis (pe64 x86_64, where `long double` IS `double`) already ran it to 42. ★ WHAT EACH ARM MEASURES, because a long-double program that returns 42 proves no fault and not that the join carried the right bits: arm 1 the ternary delivers the THEN incoming exactly; arm 2 it delivers the ELSE incoming, i.e. it SELECTS rather than always copying one side; arm 3 a long double survives 40 trips round a loop back edge and the inverse loop restores it; arm 4 FULL WIDTH — 1+2^-40 (41 mantissa bits) crosses a ternary join and comes back with its low bit intact, so a merge that round-trips through anything narrower, or copies 8 bytes of a 10-byte x87 datum, yields 0 here and not 4; arms 5-6 the conditionally-initialised local on both paths, the shape Mem2Reg promotes to a phi. ⚠ THE TWO PIPELINE ARMS MEASURE DIFFERENT CODE: at debug the ternary is the only phi and shapes 2/3 are alloca/load/store memory traffic; at release Mem2Reg promotes the long-double locals (F80/F128 moved onto `zeroFormFor`'s RodataLoad arm the day this row closed) so the loop-carried and conditional-init shapes become real phis and the merge carries them. NO long double is ever COMPARED: `FCmp` on F80/F128 is still walled by the operand width gate (a separate residual), so every check extracts exact quarters with `(int)(v*4)` and compares ints. ANTI-FOLD: every operand AND every branch condition is read from a MUTABLE GLOBAL, so release cannot fold a join away. Lowering is pinned in the unit suite (F80/F128PhiControlMergeLowersToMemoryHomeCopy and F80PhiSwapOnABackEdgeStagesEveryIncomingBeforeAnyHomeWrite in tests/lir/test_mir_to_lir.cpp — the first two INVERTED from the LD-1 walls, the third the lost-copy pin). exit = 42; each arm returns its own number so a failure names itself.
